scope: All requested sheets reviewed in temporal order at their selected times only; no continuous perceptual playback/listening or all-frame visual review.

pages.observation: Opening black frames lead into a dim-to-readable fade of the Shannon header, source citation and three-line guessing blanks. No geometric clipping at selected times; intentional fade frames are not treated as readability failures.
Yellow cursor box draws around the first blank and the Chinese guess-next-letter prompt appears below. The box closes cleanly; rows, prompt and citation remain separate.
Cursor outline enlarges/settles while the guessing prompt holds. Static interval samples retain the blank rows and source citation without visual leftovers; no clipping observed.

Cursor fades and raw English letters t, h, e reveal sequentially with individual rank-one numbers below. Letter and rank baselines remain aligned; raw data stays English appropriately in the Chinese chapter.
Incorrect y guess is pink, fades, and correct r/e letters resolve into there; rank 3 is highlighted under the relevant position. No collision between guessed letters and rank row at selected times.
Space marker is visible; incorrect w fades before the correct continuation there is n. Yellow rank emphasis stays under its corresponding character, and word/space positions remain coherent.

Incorrect t after no is removed, then the rest of the English sentence reveals across the first and second rows. Trailing-space markers and rank values stay attached to character positions; no row overflow observed.

All three sentence rows complete, including rather dramatically the other day. The rank colors distinguish harder guesses; the explanatory counting-program note begins fading in beneath the rows without covering them.
Counting-program disclosure is fully readable below the completed sentence. Rank highlighting steps through the demonstration without moving or overwriting the associated letters.
Rank emphasis resolves cleanly; a yellow rectangle begins drawing around motorcycle. Its partial outline is an expected drawing intermediate, clear of the adjacent rank row.
Motorcycle outline completes around the word and holds. The outline respects the word and leaves its rank values below unobscured.

Difficult ranks pulse larger/pink together and settle back to their baseline. Some enlarged adjacent ranks look crowded during the pulse; native frame follow-up requested before classifying this as a defect.
Rank pulse has returned to baseline. The yellow Shannon human estimate fades in below the sentence, separate from the counting-program disclosure and citation.
Human estimate holds at about one bit, range 0.6–1.3. Sentence, estimate and citation occupy distinct bands with no new overlap or clipping at selected times.
Blind-guess comparison log₂27=4.75 bits fades in below the human estimate, above the citation. The two captions remain readable and separate at selected times.
Estimate/comparison hold, then the entire guessing composition fades away together. No orphaned outline, rank or caption remains during the sampled fade-out.
Opening fade into timeline is clean. Chinese title, evenly labeled year axis and the two colored course-span bands are distinct; brief black/dim frames are transition samples.
1844 Morse marker and e = one-dot label fade in above the timeline. The vertical stem, marker, year ticks and course-span labels remain visually separate.
Hartley 1928 appears below the axis and Shannon 1948 above it. Staggering preserves separation from each other and existing Morse marker.
1951 guessing game, 1952 Huffman and 1976 arithmetic coding enter the denser timeline region. Their above/below offsets prevent label collisions at the selected intermediate and settled times.
Completed classical timeline holds, then 2003 neural language model and 2019 GPT-2 begin entering at the right. New labels remain within frame and outside existing stems.
2025 Qwen3 completes the timeline. Dense 1948–1952 labels remain staggered and the 2019/2025 labels remain clear at the right edge; no observed collision during entry or hold.
Complete timeline holds through small marker emphasis changes; no marker leaves its year position or produces an orphaned label.
Timeline fades out as one composition, then the English Eiffel Tower model-input sentence starts entering. No timeline remnants overlap the new content at the inspected transition times.

Eiffel Tower prompt and orange next-token box draw in cleanly; GPT-2 top-five token/probability rows begin revealing below. Verbatim model-input English is intentional; Chinese explanatory footer is separate.
GPT-2 top-five rows finish revealing and its model/parameter/year heading appears above them. Green emphasis highlights probabilities/tokens without shifting rows or obscuring numbers.
Qwen3-4B heading and top-five rows enter on the right; whitespace/newline tokens remain verbatim model data. Shared row heights, labels and probabilities align without overlap.
Both Paris rows pulse green and enlarge briefly, then settle. Labels, bars and numeric values retain clear spacing, unlike the earlier dense rank-row pulse.

Probability tables crossfade out while the token-definition inset enters; the brief overlapping layers are transition frames and resolve completely. Token pieces, word/subword/punctuation labels and rounded inset remain inside the frame.
Token inset holds legibly beneath the raw prompt, then begins fading out. Colored token boxes preserve their labels and spacing; no residual probability bars remain in the settled inset.

Token example fades out, then the larger Chinese knowledge question writes in above a smaller Eiffel Tower prompt. Partial Chinese strokes are expected Write-animation intermediates; settled text is clear and not clipped.
Question/prompt crossfade into the course map. Brief layered text during transition resolves; settled title and six map headings occupy separate bands.

Course-map title/headings settle, then foundation entries 1–5 fade in. Current Part 1 is highlighted yellow; subordinate entries are intentionally small and subdued at preview resolution, without clipping.

Learning entries 6–12 populate the second column. Column widths and line spacing stay consistent; secondary text is small at 480p, so final-resolution/mobile legibility is not certified by this preview.
Transformer entries 13–19 appear in the third column. Their final lines remain above the next map row; no overlap with generation/perception headings.
Generation/perception and agent entries populate the lower map row. Numbered lists stay in their assigned columns and clear the preview frame edge at selected times.
Finale entries 30–31 complete the course map; all six groups remain separated. No population/reveal animation leaves duplicate entries or stray text.
Yellow rounded rectangle draws around Part 1 only. Its corners and stroke leave the title line and the following Part 2 line clear.
Course map holds with the current-part outline. Subordinate lists remain stable, with no new visual artifact during small emphasis changes.
Map fades out cleanly, followed by the Part 1 chapter-plan title beginning to fade in. No old map text remains readable over the new title at settled times.

Objectives list reveals progressively from title-only to seven items. Detector missed most slow 178–203s animation: its static-midpoint sample at 190.599s shows a partly revealed list. Additional native-time follow-up is required; this interval is not credited as densely covered by the original sheets.
Completed seven objectives hold without overlapping numbered circles or neighboring lines, then begin fading out. Long coding/language-model objective lines remain within the frame.
Objectives fade out, then the scoreboard/quoted passage and plain-text baseline enter. Quote, source/data caveat and chart occupy distinct vertical bands with no settled overlap.

Only the plain-text 8.01 bits/character row is revealed; remaining chart rows are intentionally subdued placeholders. Its emphasis pulse stays clear of labels and value, and the chart remains within the frame.
Remaining scoreboard labels become more visible while scores stay hidden. The plain-text baseline, passage quote and data/contamination caveat hold without clipping.
Scoreboard holds to the closing beat, then fades nearly to black by the last decoded frame. No orphaned chart label or earlier-scene object remains at the selected ending times.

confirmed_bugs.observation: Simultaneous 1.8× rank pulses crowd adjacent numeric columns, reducing count-to-character readability during the 1.5-second emphasis animation.
confirmed_bugs.suggestion: Use color/opacity emphasis or constrain each pulse width to its character cell.

limits: Every source frame was decoded and analyzed, not visually inspected.
Only listed native-resolution times were extracted; review of those images is pending.
Low-resolution RGB thresholds can miss small or subtle spatial/channel changes.
Static interval midpoints are samples, not proof that their full intervals are unchanged.
Full perceptual playback and listening remain unverified.

coverage_gaps.explanation: Long LaggedStart/FadeIn changes below adjacent-frame RGB thresholds were classified as static; original sheets do not supply dense temporal review here.
coverage_gaps.remaining_gap: Supplemental views are about three seconds apart; unlisted times and all-frame perceptual review remain unverified. Root requested bounded max-gap v2 extraction.
